pages.text: Apotheosis gems slot into socketed equipment for permanent stat bonuses. An item's affix tier sets its socket count: Common items have 0 sockets, Legendary items can have up to 4.$(br2)Gems come in 5 quality tiers, from worst to best: $(bold)Flawed, Chipped, Normal, Flawless, Perfect.$() Better gems give stronger bonuses.

$(bold)Where Gems Come From$()$(br2)Gem quality rises with boss tier:$(br)$(li)T1 bosses and Overworld chests: Flawed, Chipped$(li)T2 bosses and Dimensional chests: Normal, Flawless$(li)T3 bosses and Nether/Abyss chests: Flawless, Perfect$(li)T4 bosses and End chests: Perfect$(br2)Loot boxes can also drop gems at the matching tier.

$(bold)Gem Cutting Table$()$(br2)The Gem Cutting Table (Apotheosis) upgrades gems by combining them:$(br)$(li)3 Flawed into 1 Chipped$(li)3 Chipped into 1 Normal$(li)3 Normal into 1 Flawless$(li)3 Flawless into 1 Perfect$(br2)The table is a Tier 2 craft (it takes a T2 token), so gem cutting opens up in the mid-game.
